design_rule: One edition is one independently identified text witness. Never merge different editions or languages into one text field.

editions.name: Westminster Leningrad Codex
editions.notes: Imported 23,213 verse records across all 39 Masoretic books. Full exact-key and text comparison against the downloaded eBible USFM source archive passed: zero missing, extra, or mismatched records. WLC text only; separate morphology/lemma data excluded. Not the full Coptic Orthodox OT canon and does not contain Deuterocanonical books.

editions.name: Rahlfs Septuagint 1935
editions.notes: Open Scriptorium lists Rahlfs Septuagint 1935 as Public Domain and offers an import task. Verify the exact source artifact, edition metadata, and book coverage before import.

editions.name: Brenton Greek Septuagint 1851
editions.notes: طبعة تاريخية متاحة رقميًا. تُعرض كطبعة مستقلة ولا تُخلط مع رالفز.

editions.name: Coptic New Testament (Bohairic)
editions.license: Public Domain as listed by source catalog; verify edition notice
editions.notes: eBible labels it Public Domain. It is based on Horner and standardized by J. Warren Wells; the source explicitly calls the work ongoing. Audit against Horner's edition and record the standardization before app use.

editions.name: SBL Greek New Testament
editions.notes: SBLGNT is CC BY 4.0, but the SBL end-user license adds conditions: attribution; annual reporting when distributing for use with a commercial product or more than 500 verses; and no Greek-English diglot without a license. Keep Greek and English as separate reader selections unless written permission is obtained for a side-by-side Greek-English edition.

editions.name: 1904 Patriarchal Greek New Testament
editions.notes: إضافة اختيارية للمقارنة النصية، ولا يحل محل النص النقدي SBLGNT.

editions.name: World English Bible British Edition with Deuterocanon
editions.display_name_ar: الكتاب المقدس بالإنجليزية — WEB البريطانية مع الأسفار القانونية الثانية
editions.notes: eBible identifies the edition as Public Domain, provides USFM/USFX downloads, and explicitly says it includes Apocrypha/Deuterocanon. Preserve its actual book set and naming; do not claim its canon exactly matches Coptic Orthodox until compared book-by-book.

editions.name: Biblica Open New Arabic Version 2012
editions.notes: Biblica Open New Arabic Version 2012. Keep attribution and share-alike license; does not include the Deuterocanonical books.

editions.name: Smith–Van Dyck Arabic Bible 1865
editions.notes: The currently imported Smith–Van Dyck 1865 corpus is stored independently. It does not include the Deuterocanonical books.

editions.name: Bohairic Old Testament corpus — Coptic SCRIPTORIUM
editions.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 per Coptic Reader source listing
editions.notes: Research corpus with TEI and corpus downloads. Preserve manuscript/text witness identity and source references. The surviving Bohairic evidence does not cover every Old Testament book; do not infer missing books or additions.

alignment_policy.canonical_book_ids: Use stable internal book IDs from the canon catalog; keep source-specific book codes as aliases.
alignment_policy.verse_alignment: Never assume identical chapter or verse numbering across Hebrew, Septuagint, Greek NT, Coptic dialects, and translations.
alignment_policy.rule: Keep original source numbering and add a separate cross-edition alignment layer. Never silently renumber, merge, or fabricate missing verses.

acceptance_gates: Verify source edition identity and exact downloadable artifact.
Verify license and redistribution conditions for the exact artifact, not just the website or software.
Record source checksums, edition metadata, dialect, textual tradition, and retrieval date.
Audit books, chapters, verses, and textual additions against the chosen edition.
Run sample comparisons and report omissions, duplicates, and numbering differences.
Only then mark an edition ready_for_app.
